payload.name: Poker: play, practice, improve
payload.description: 扑克训练：教练指导、策略与分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Play Texas Hold’em poker with an AI opponent, then talk about every hand with ChatGPT. This is more than a poker game. It is a place to play, learn, ask questions, and get better one hand at a time. If you are new to poker, the AI can help you understand what is happening. If you already know the game, you can test ideas, try new plans, and review your choices. Every game becomes a chance to learn.

You can sit down and start playing in just a few moments. The game follows the rules of Texas Hold’em. Cards are dealt, bets are made, and each hand plays out like a real game. When the hand ends, you can ask ChatGPT why something happened. Ask why a bet was good, why a fold was smart, or why a bluff worked. You can keep asking until it makes sense.

Learning poker does not have to feel hard. Big ideas are explained with small, simple words. If you do not know what a flop, turn, river, or blind is, just ask. If you want to know what pot odds mean, ask. If you want help reading the board or choosing between calling, raising, or folding, ask. The AI explains each step in a clear and friendly way.

You are free to play the way you want. Try safe play. Try bold play. Bluff more. Bluff less. See what happens. If something goes well, ask why. If something goes wrong, ask what you could do next time. Every choice is a chance to learn something new.

This is not only for beginners. Players with more experience can explore strategy, compare ideas, and think through tough spots. Talk about hand ranges, position, value betting, drawing hands, and bluff catching. Ask what other lines were possible. Ask what a different player might do. The conversation can go as deep as you want.

There is no rush. Take your time before every move. Think about your cards. Look at the board. Consider what your opponent may have. Then decide. After the hand, talk about the result. Learning happens before, during, and after every game.

Because ChatGPT is part of the experience, every session can be different. You can ask simple questions or difficult ones. You can ask for short answers or longer lessons. You can even ask the AI to explain things as if you are five years old. The game grows with your skill level.

Use this app to practice without the pressure of a real poker table. Try ideas you have never tested before. Make mistakes. Learn from them. Build confidence hand after hand. Poker is a game of skill, patience, and good decisions, and practice helps every player improve.

Whether you want a quick game during a break or a longer session to study strategy, this app is ready. Play a few hands. Play a full game. Stop to ask questions whenever you like. Every conversation helps you understand the game a little better.

If you enjoy games that make you think, if you want to improve at Texas Hold’em, or if you simply want to play poker with an AI that can explain its thinking, this app is made for you. Deal the cards. Make your move. Ask your questions. Learn something new. Then play the next hand with a little more confidence than before.

payload.name: Movie Find: Film Lookup+Search
payload.description: 查电影详情：演员、剧照、预告片
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Finding a movie should be easy. This ChatGPT app helps you discover, explore, and learn about movies without leaving your conversation. Ask about almost any movie and get clear information in one place. Whether you already know what you want or just want ideas for movie night, this app makes it simple. Instead of opening many websites and searching over and over, you can ask in plain words and keep chatting. It feels natural, fast, and fun.

Once you find a movie, you can learn more about it. See the story, the main cast, the director, the release year, the running time, and other helpful details. Learn who plays each character. Find out what other movies an actor has been in. Explore the work of a director. Jump from one movie to another without starting a new search.

The app is great for quick questions too. See when a movie came out. See who stars in it. See who directed it. See how long it is. See what it is about before you decide to watch it. Everything stays inside your chat, making it easy to keep exploring.

If you enjoy learning about film, this app is a fun way to discover connections. See actors in different movies. See famous directors. Find movie series and collections. Compare different films. Learn about old classics and brand-new releases. Every question can lead to another interesting discovery.

The app works well for casual movie fans and people who love films. You do not need to know movie trivia or remember exact names. Just ask naturally. The conversation keeps going, so you can ask follow-up questions without repeating yourself. That makes exploring movies feel smooth and simple.

Everything is designed to help you spend less time searching and more time enjoying movies. Instead of jumping between pages, you can browse, discover, compare, and learn in one place. It is an easy way to explore the world of film through natural conversation.

Whether you want your next favorite movie, information about a classic, details about a new release, or help remembering a film from years ago, this ChatGPT app is ready to help. Ask simple questions, explore deeper, and enjoy discovering movies one conversation at a time.

payload.name: Leyware
payload.description: 在 Steam 上搜索游戏

Discover your next favorite Steam game with AI-powered search and review analysis. 

Search over 120,000 Steam games using natural language — just describe what you're looking for ("cozy farming games" or "challenging roguelikes with great soundtrack") and browse results with trailers, screenshots, and pricing.

Get instant AI summaries of Steam reviews that distill thousands of player opinions into clear insights about what works and what doesn't. Filter by sentiment, playtime, and language.

Explore deeper analytics across 4.3M roguelite game reviews to see how player sentiment evolves over playtime, compare top titles, and search what players actually say about specific topics like "difficulty," "multiplayer," or "replayability."

All data comes directly from Steam, no web searches, just real player feedback.

payload.name: Pitch 1024

Build a chord with several voices harmonizing together — in stereo, or in full 3D around you on headphones — pass a progression around the ensemble one singer per chord, or drill your ear with hidden-answer note, interval, and chord-quality quizzes.

Useful for singers warming up, a cappella groups finding their starting pitches, instrumentalists tuning by ear, and anyone who'd rather match a real voice than a tone generator.

payload.name: Baseball-Teams/Schedules/Stats
payload.description: 追踪比分、比赛与局数，边看边聊
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Follow every baseball game without leaving ChatGPT. Get live MLB scores, game schedules, standings, team records, and game results right inside your conversation. Ask about today’s games, check who won, see what is coming next, or look at the latest standings. You do not need to open another website or switch to another app. Just ask your question and get the baseball information you want in one place.

If you want to know what games are happening today, simply ask. If you want to see yesterday’s scores, ask that too. You can check upcoming games, recent results, and how every team is doing during the season. Whether you follow one favorite club or every team in Major League Baseball, finding information is quick and easy.

See live scores while games are being played. Find out who is winning, who has already finished, and which games have not started yet. Keep up with the action throughout the day without searching across different websites. Everything is shown inside your chat so you can spend more time enjoying baseball.

Need to check the standings? You can see how every team ranks in its division. Follow the race to the playoffs and watch teams move up or down as the season goes on. Check team records, wins, losses, and where clubs stand compared with their rivals.

You can also look ahead. Find upcoming games, see who plays next, and plan which matchups you want to watch. Whether you are getting ready for tonight’s game or looking several days ahead, schedules are easy to find.

This app is made for baseball fans of every kind. Maybe you watch every game. Maybe you only follow your hometown team. Maybe you just want to know today’s scores. No matter how closely you follow MLB, getting the information you need is simple.

Ask questions in your own words. You do not need special commands or complicated menus. Try questions like “Who won the Dodgers game?”, “What MLB games are on today?”, “Show me the AL East standings,” or “When do the Cubs play next?” The app understands natural questions and helps you find the answer.

Everything happens inside ChatGPT, so you can keep talking without changing apps. Ask one question or ask many. Compare teams, check schedules, see standings, and follow scores in the same conversation. It feels like talking with someone who is always ready to help with baseball information.

The app is useful all season long. Check Opening Day games, follow exciting division races, watch the push toward the playoffs, and keep up during the postseason. Whenever games are happening, you can quickly see what is going on.

Whether you cheer for the Yankees, Dodgers, Cubs, Braves, Mets, Red Sox, Phillies, Astros, Padres, Mariners, or any other MLB team, you can easily keep track of scores, schedules, standings, and results. Follow your favorite club or explore the whole league.

Use this app when you want baseball information that is fast, clear, and easy to understand. Stay up to date with live MLB scores, today’s games, completed results, upcoming schedules, team records, division standings, and season progress without leaving your conversation. Just ask a question, get the latest baseball information, and enjoy the game.

payload.name: Savecraft
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Savecraft connects your actual game save data to ChatGPT. Instead of describing your character, gear, and progress from memory, Savecraft reads your real save files and game API profiles so the AI can give you specific, personalized advice.

Ask about your build, compare your gear to a guide, check drop rates with exact math, or just talk about your run: ChatGPT already knows your character. Attach notes like build guides or farming checklists, and the AI can track your progress against them over time.

Premade expert reference modules use your save data to coach you. Draft advisors, drop calculators, crop planners, all grounded in real math.

payload.name: No Bike No Life
payload.description: 摩托车、骑行路线与天气
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
No Bike No Life beantwortet Motorradfragen mit Daten aus dem NBNL-Katalog.

Kaufberatung: Ein Dialog aus neun Fragen zu Nutzung, Erfahrung, Führerschein, Körpergröße und Budget führt zu passenden Modellen — mit Bild, Eckdaten und Begründung, warum ein Motorrad passt.

Katalog: Modelle suchen, Details ansehen, bis zu fünf Maschinen in einer Tabelle vergleichen.

Routen: Strecken zwischen zwei Punkten oder Rundtouren planen, mit Kurvigkeit, Höhenprofil und dem Wetter entlang der Route auf der Karte.

Wetter: Mehrtägige Vorhersage mit Fahrbarkeits-Bewertung, Zustand der Alpenpässe und ein Kompass, der zeigt, in welche Himmelsrichtung sich die Ausfahrt heute lohnt.

Anfängerwissen: Über 200 beantwortete Einsteigerfragen zu Technik, Wartung und Fahrpraxis.

Alle Angaben stammen aus dem redaktionell gepflegten Katalog von nbnl.de. Modellfotos sind Herstellermaterial und mit Quelle gekennzeichnet.

payload.name: SessionKeeper

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SessionKeeper is a companion app for D&D and tabletop RPG groups. Connect your account to look up session transcripts, summaries, character details, wiki entries, and DM prep notes.. all from within ChatGPT.

Ask what happened in your last game, search your campaign wiki, review character backstories, or pull up DM prep. If you record your sessions with SessionKeeper, all your game data is at your fingertips.

- What are the tour dates for a performer or comedian?

Find your next live experience with the Vivid Seats app.

payload.name: Phish.in

This legal open source site is carefully maintained by phans to help music lovers discover and enjoy the music of the popular improvisational rock band. Search and browse the database by song, venue, tour, and more. Play audio without leaving ChatGPT.

payload.name: OTTASIA

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: OTTASIA answers the question streaming search gets wrong outside the US: where can I legally watch this, HERE? Coverage spans 34 markets (India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Korea, Japan, the Gulf and more, plus the US, UK, Canada and Australia for the diaspora) and 60+ services, including regional platforms global tools miss (JioHotstar, ZEE5, Sun NXT, Aha, Hoichoi, Chorki, ARY Plus, Shahid, Viu, iQIYI). Availability comes from live data, including OTTASIA's own daily catalog scans of local services and free official-YouTube channels for Pakistani dramas. Also answers what's new on any service in any market, and finds titles across languages (English, romanized, or original script).

payload.name: Magic Tips
payload.description: 找迪士尼乐园人少的日期
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Magic Tips turns "when should we go?" into a concrete answer.

Ask for a resort and a month, and you get a daily crowd score from 1 to 10
with the predicted wait-time level for each date — across Disneyland Paris,
Walt Disney World, Disneyland Resort (California), Tokyo Disney Resort,
Hong Kong Disneyland and Shanghai Disney Resort. Scores are built from
historical wait-time observations, school and public holiday calendars,
weather data and seasonal events, then normalised against each park's own
demand range.

It also answers the questions that come next:
• Attraction catalogues per park — minimum height, ride duration, must-do
  flag and community rating
• Which restaurants serve a given dish, searched across every resort
  ("vegan", "turkey leg", "mickey waffle")
• Resort FAQs and a plain-language glossary of planning jargon (Lightning
  Lane, DAS, rope drop), available in 13 languages

Scope and limits, stated plainly: coverage is Disney parks and Disney
Cruise Line — not Universal. The attraction catalogue is static and does
not include live wait times or ride closures. Crowd scores are forecasts,
not guarantees; the methodology and its known limits are published at
https://magic-tips.app/en/methodology

Magic Tips is an independent, fan-made project. It is not affiliated with,
endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to The Walt Disney
Company or any of its subsidiaries or affiliates. Park, attraction and
character names are trademarks of their respective owners and are used
here only to identify the places this tool covers.

payload.name: diggercamp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: diggercamp finds music that actually sounds alike. Paste a Bandcamp, YouTube or SoundCloud link and it returns tracks with a similar sound, analysed by rhythm, timbre, key and energy rather than tags or popularity. Dig deeper from a track you love, build a DJ set with key- and tempo-aware matching, find tracks that fit a whole playlist, or generate and save a full set that starts from one track and develops from there. Every result comes with a link to listen on its original source. You sign in with your diggercamp account, and your plan sets the limits.

The app works like a hockey helper. You can ask short questions or longer ones. You can say things like “Who plays tonight?”, “Did the Oilers win?”, “Show me the Eastern Conference standings,” or “When do the Rangers play next?” The app understands natural language, so you do not have to learn special commands.

Follow one team or every team. Keep up with the regular season, the playoffs, and important games. Find schedules, scores, and standings in seconds. Whether you watch every game or only check in once in a while, the information is easy to find.

Player information is also simple to explore. Ask about a player and learn which team they play for, their position, and other useful details. Compare players, check team matchups, or look up game information before the puck drops.

Need a quick answer during a game? Ask for the live score. Want to know what happened after the game ends? Ask for the final score. Looking ahead? Check upcoming games and schedules. Looking back? Review recent results. The app helps you stay connected all season long.

Everything happens inside your conversation. There is no need to jump between tabs or search through many pages. Just ask another question and keep going. It feels like talking with a friend who always knows what is happening around the NHL.

The app is built to be clear and easy to use. Answers are organized so they are simple to read. Whether you ask one question or many, the goal is to help you find hockey information quickly.

Great for longtime fans. Great for new fans. Great for people learning about hockey. If you know every player, you can dive into detailed information. If you are just starting to watch the NHL, you can ask basic questions and learn as you go.

Use the app to check scores before work, during lunch, after school, or before bed. See who is winning, who is climbing the standings, and what games are coming next. Keep track of your favorite team throughout the season without extra searching.

You can ask about today’s games, tomorrow’s games, team records, conference standings, division standings, schedules, results, matchups, and more. The app is made to help you find hockey information in a simple and friendly way.

Whether you want a fast score check, a full schedule, the latest standings, player information, or answers to everyday NHL questions, this app keeps everything together inside ChatGPT. Ask, explore, and stay up to date with the National Hockey League from one easy conversation.

payload.name: JamBase
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: JamBase brings live music data into ChatGPT so you can find shows worth your time without juggling ten different ticketing sites. Search concerts and festivals by artist, venue, city, genre, or date with quick shortcuts like "this weekend" or "next weekend." Track when your favorite bands are touring near you, plan trips around festival lineups, find music livestreams, and ask questions like "what's worth seeing in Brooklyn this weekend?" or "are Phish or Khruangbin touring near Chicago this fall?" payload.name: AstroBella Astrology
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask for your birth chart and you get it drawn, not just described. Give a birth date, time and place, and AstroBella Astrology builds the full natal chart and a wheel you can actually explore — click any planet to see its exact degree, the sign and house it falls in, and every aspect it makes.

What you can ask for:

• Your natal chart — every placement, your rising sign and midheaven, the houses and the complete aspect list, with the wheel drawn beside it.

• What's happening right now — the transits currently touching your chart, or a scan of the coming weeks and months that shows the exact date each one peaks and how long it stays in effect.

• You and someone else — a compatibility comparison that lays out every contact between two charts, closest first.

• Quick sky questions — is Mercury retrograde, what sign is the Moon in, when is the next full moon. These need no birth details at all.

If you don't know your birth time, you still get a chart. The app tells you which parts it cannot determine without it — rising sign, midheaven and houses — instead of quietly guessing them.

Birthplaces are matched against a built-in list of over 120,000 towns and cities, so a small home town works as well as a capital. When a name is genuinely shared — Springfield, or the London in Ontario — you are asked which one you mean instead of being guessed at.

Planets are placed at their real degrees rather than rounded into a sign, and every chart is worked out fresh from astronomical data when you ask for it.

payload.name: Regal

payload.name: Ticketbox.vn
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ticketbox helps people discover events across Vietnam, including concerts, shows, workshops, sports, and other live experiences. Search events, view details, showtimes, venues, and ticket prices, then continue on ticketbox.vn to complete checkout. Supports Vietnamese and English.

payload.name: FICTURN
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 里读短篇小说
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FICTURN lets users browse and read short, finished fiction directly inside ChatGPT. The current library includes romantic suspense, uncanny horror, and near-future speculative fiction, presented in an inline reader with progress, Previous and Continue navigation, and a Library view. FICTURN serves fixed story text and does not generate or rewrite the prose on the fly.

payload.name: Born To Banger
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Born To Banger helps you find and book curated event activities, workshops, and live entertainment across Delhi NCR. Browse 50+ experiences – caricature artists, face painting, balloon twisting, canvas painting, DIY workshops, and more – for birthdays, weddings, corporate events, school fests, and housing society celebrations.

Tell us your event date, location, and guest count, and we'll recommend the right activities, confirm availability, and handle everything on the day. Served across Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Ghaziabad, and Faridabad.

payload.name: Fairy Forge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fairy Forge helps parents browse a children’s audio fairy-tale library, open listen links on fairy-forge.com, save favorites, and check account usage inside ChatGPT. Sign-in is required. The experience is intended for parents and guardians; stories are for children.

payload.name: Fever Event Discovery
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover and explore live entertainment experiences worldwide through Fever. Search events by city, date, location, or keyword across concerts, shows, festivals, immersive experiences, and more. Filter by popularity, price, rating, or proximity. Get event details including schedules, venues, ratings, and pricing.

payload.name: Gomoku
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Play a complete game of Gomoku against AI without leaving ChatGPT or creating another account. Start instantly on the official 15×15 tournament board, choose Black or White, and match your skill with Easy, Normal, or Hard AI. You can also request a quick 13×13 game or a spacious 19×19 board. Pick Standard Gomoku, Freestyle Five in a Row, or professional Renju rules with Black’s overline, double-four, and double-three forbidden moves. Pro and Long Pro openings are available to reduce Black’s first-move advantage. The interactive board marks forbidden points, highlights the latest stone, displays move numbers, and warns when your opponent can win on the next turn. Two-tap move confirmation helps prevent mistakes on mobile, while undo and resign keep the game flexible. After the final move, the winning five and result appear immediately. Whether you call it Gomoku, Five in a Row, Renju, Omok, or Gobang, this is a fast, polished way to challenge an AI at your level.

payload.name: Inviton
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Inviton helps you discover real-world events happening across Slovakia, Czechia, Poland and nearby regions directly inside ChatGPT.

Find concerts, festivals, cultural events, nightlife, exhibitions, and activities based on your city, date, or preferences. Inviton retrieves live public event data from multiple trusted sources and provides structured recommendations including event details, images, and official ticket links.

Simply ask what’s happening this weekend, tonight, or in any city, and Inviton will recommend relevant events in real time.

payload.name: Seat Unique
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover unforgettable live experiences with the Seat Unique ChatGPT App — your personalized gateway to premium tickets, official hospitality packages, and VIP access for the biggest sport, music, and cultural events. Whether you’re chasing front-row seats to a Premier League match, VIP concert access, or hospitality at iconic venues, this app helps you find and book the perfect experience — quickly, securely, and with expert guidance.  ￼

With Seat Unique ChatGPT, you can:
	•	Explore and compare premium experiences tailored to your favourite teams, artists and venues.  ￼
	•	Get instant recommendations for tickets and hospitality packages that match your preferences.
	•	Book confidently with clear, official information straight from the source.
	•	Receive personalised alerts and tips so you never miss a must-see event or exclusive offer.

Fans love Seat Unique because it makes premium experiences accessible and easy to navigate — all in one place. Whether you’re planning a special trip, a memorable gift, or the ultimate fan day out, this app brings you closer to the moments that matter most.

payload.name: Wordspace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Guess your way toward the mystery word at the center. Words closer in meaning sit closer to it: each guess gets a closeness rank on the board, each turn reveals a new clue word, and you have ten guesses to close the distance. A new word drops every day, the nine before it wait in the archive. Share your game with friends, spoiler-free.

Wordspace is free, requires no account, and plays on web and mobile.

payload.name: AskLingxi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AskLingxi helps you generate traditional Chinese BaZi (Four Pillars) charts and explore AI-assisted interpretations based on traditional BaZi principles.

Features include:
• Generate BaZi charts from birth information
• Analyze the Five Elements and chart structure
• Explain luck cycles and annual influences
• Explore personality and life pattern interpretations
• Compare charts for relationship compatibility
• Ask follow-up questions about your BaZi chart

payload.name: Alton Towers Tickets
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Planning a visit to Alton Towers? Experience over 40 rides and attractions, including world-class rollercoasters.  Browse available tickets, choose your visit dates, and manage your cart — all right inside ChatGPT. When you're ready, check out on the Alton Towers ticketing website.

 Features
	- Browse available tickets and pricing
	- Pick your preferred visit dates
	- Start and manage your cart

payload.name: U.S. Open Golf Companion
payload.description: 美国公开赛高尔夫助手：实时比分与资讯
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your real-time companion for the 2026 U.S. Open Championship at Shinnecock Hills. Ask about live scores, tee times, where to watch, and everything you need to follow the action — from the leaderboard to the fan guide.

payload.name: Seatpin
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find tickets to football matches, concerts, and live events worldwide in seconds.

How Seatpin helps you:

Browse events – Discover matches, concerts, and experiences across Europe and beyond. Plan your next trip or weekend with ease (e.g. “What matches are happening in Milan this weekend?”)

Compare tickets – Explore multiple listings from independent sellers, compare prices, seating options, and availability in one place.

Find the best deals – Access competitive marketplace pricing and find tickets that fit your budget (e.g. “Best seats under €150”)

Use Seatpin to:
	•	Find football matches and major events worldwide
	•	Compare ticket options across multiple sellers
	•	Discover last-minute availability

Seatpin is a global ticket marketplace connecting buyers and independent sellers.

payload.name: Bardkeeper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Give ChatGPT access to your Bardkeeper campaigns to help plan future sessions, summarize story arcs, answer lore questions, track NPCs, and keep your world's continuity intact.

payload.name: Domono
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Play a focused round of Egyptian dominoes against Domo directly in ChatGPT. Domono handles the rules, legal moves, hidden tiles, and scoring, with an interactive board available in English and Arabic. No account or purchase is required.

payload.name: PoGo Showcase Manager
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to the PoGo Showcase Manager through its MCP server.

payload.name: emaqi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: emaqi helps people discover English-language manga through title search, genre browsing, trending picks, and mood-based recommendations. It first gathers and narrows promising candidates, then presents the result in the final UI: a list UI for a final shortlist of selected titles, or a detail page for one chosen manga.

payload.name: CineOS
payload.description: 查英国影院正在上映什么
payload.summaryOriginal: Find what's on at UK cinemas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI-native film and cinema discovery for the UK with verified showtimes and direct booking links.

payload.name: Imagina RPG
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
This plugin allows you to handle Imagina RPG authoring functions form ChatGPT:
 - Author worlds (create, edit, review)
 - Debug your journeys
 - Get analytics about your worlds

payload.name: The Big Answer
payload.summaryOriginal: Survey quiz solo vs the World
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Start a  survey quiz in ChatGPT. Host an async game with friends — invite your crew with a link, everyone answers five funny questions on their own time, and when the game finishes you get results, a reveal, and email. Or play solo vs the World: pick a question pack, score your answers, and climb the pack leaderboard. Answer in the widget or say your answers in chat.

payload.name: udictio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: udictio is a social dictionary where users explore public, attributed definitions, interpretations, opinions, and lived experiences about concepts, feelings, places, people, works, events, and everyday topics. it finds matching topics, returns up to five entries at a time, opens complete entries on demand, and links each result to its original udictio page. contributions are subjective user perspectives rather than verified facts, consensus, or representative survey results. the read-only app requires no udictio account.

payload.name: TownSpot Events
payload.description: 发现您附近的本地活动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover what is on in your city or neighbourhood with genuinely local event listings spotted by local people. Find useful options for tonight, tomorrow, or this weekend, including free events, live music, and family activities. Results include local times, venues, neighbourhoods, prices, public spotter credit, and links to current TownSpot pages. TownSpot Events is read-only and cannot create, edit, book, or purchase events.
payload.longDescription: 通过本地居民发现的真实本地活动列表，了解您所在城市或社区的精彩活动。查找今晚、明天或本周末的实用选项，包括免费活动、现场音乐和家庭活动。结果包含本地时间、场所、社区、价格、公众推荐者信用信息以及当前TownSpot页面的链接。TownSpot Events为只读插件，无法创建、编辑、预订或购买活动。

payload.name: Happens.mk
payload.description: 斯科普里实时活动指南
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Live guide to Skopje - refreshed daily: concerts, theatre, film, sport and kids' events with times, venues, prices and tickets.

payload.name: Leela Online
payload.description: 当你原地打转时的指引
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Something in your life keeps coming back to the same place — the same argument, the same work you have outgrown, the same feeling of carrying everyone and being unseen. You know the loop. You cannot see it from inside it.

Leela opens a board in this chat and puts a Guide beside you. First the Guide helps you say the one question you actually came with, not the polished version of it. Then you throw the die once, and the square you land on answers a piece of that question — in your own words, not a horoscope.

Leela (Gyan Chauper) is a real Indian game of self-knowledge: seventy-two squares with snakes and arrows, played for centuries before it travelled west and became Snakes and Ladders. The full walk across all seventy-two, with the Guide on every square, continues on the site.

payload.name: StreamExpose
payload.description: 筹备 YouTube 直播电台
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: StreamExpose helps creators prepare one free 24/7 YouTube live radio from ChatGPT. It can open the StreamExpose setup wizard or prefill it with a station name, description, audio source, background, privacy setting, and YouTube mode. Users review the setup, sign in, authorize YouTube when required, and explicitly launch the radio on StreamExpose. The ChatGPT app does not advertise or facilitate purchases.

payload.name: drawnames
payload.description: 组织你的圣诞老人抽签
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use drawnames to organize your Secret Santa gift exchange through a simple, step-by-step conversation. Name your gift exchange, set a budget, pick a date, optionally add exclusions, and draw names. When everything is set, share the invitation with your loved ones and let the magic begin!

payload.name: Etkinlinkler
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Türkiye’deki konser, festival, tiyatro ve diğer etkinlikleri keşfedin. Etkinlik detaylarını görüntüleyin ve farklı bilet platformlarındaki fiyatları karşılaştırarak size uygun seçeneği bulun.

payload.name: KinElo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: KinElo helps you search movies, review your ratings and bookmarks, see global rankings, and get personalized movie recommendations from your KinElo account.

payload.name: Tyra
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tyra is your going-out concierge for NYC nightlife and events. Ask in plain language — "what's the move tonight?", "day parties in Brooklyn this weekend", or "date night ideas in Harlem" — and Tyra returns hand-curated NYC events with images, dates, locations, and summaries, shown as an interactive carousel, list, and map you can explore right inside ChatGPT.

Browse events visually, open a map to see what's happening near a neighborhood, tap any event for full details, and jump out to RSVP or buy tickets at the source. Tyra covers nightlife, day parties, live music, and culture across the city.

Tyra is read-only: it surfaces and displays events. It never posts, books, messages, or changes anything on your behalf.

payload.name: Sena
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sena.lt

Vintage & secondhand marketplace

Search more than 500,000 listings on Lithuania's marketplace for preloved, vintage and out-of-print finds — rare books and first editions, collectible vinyl records, retro board games, and one-of-a-kind home and interior pieces.

Ask in plain language for a title, an author, an artist, a genre or an era. Narrow results by price, publication year, language, category and item type, or sort by cheapest first. Open any listing to see its condition, photos, seller and description, and ask for more listings like it.

Every result comes back with a direct link to the listing on sena.lt, where you contact the seller and complete the purchase.

Sena searches the public catalogue only. It does not sign you in, post or edit listings, or read your account.

Sena helps you give things a second life — resale made simple, sustainable and local.

payload.name: Tonk
payload.description: 你的纳什维尔音乐经纪人
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tonk helps you find the Nashville shows worth your night. With your approval, it can carry over music tastes and trip details you’ve reviewed in ChatGPT—or a compact sample from a connected music service—and turn them into a personal taste profile. Search Tonk’s maintained catalog of Nashville shows, artists, venues, and neighborhoods for a short list that fits your taste, vibe, location, and timing, whether you live here or are planning a visit. Find the right band and the right room without endless scrolling.

payload.name: Astera Oracle & Numerology
payload.description: 维多利亚神谕与数字命理
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Astera Oracle & Numerology combines a 36-card Victorian Oracle with deterministic Pythagorean numerology. Use it for daily cards, Yes/No readings, relationship and situation spreads, Life Path and Name Number calculations, compatibility, personal cycles, and deeper numerology profiles. Oracle readings can include the original card artwork. Interpretations are intended for personal reflection and entertainment, not professional advice.

payload.name: Interestnaut
payload.description: 发现值得看、读、玩的东西
payload.summaryOriginal: Find what to watch, read, play
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Interestnaut grounds recommendations in what you have actually reacted to and rated — across films, TV, books, games, music, podcasts and creators — instead of guessing from genre labels. ChatGPT can read your reaction history, your 1-10 ratings, and your computed taste profile, and search the catalog by title across all seven media types. Ratings carry the most signal: they are sparse and deliberate, so a 9 means considerably more than a like. Reactions are not interchangeable either — "meh" means you consumed something and felt nothing, while "skipped" means you passed without engaging and carries no opinion at all. With your permission it can also record reactions and ratings, so you can keep your library current without leaving the conversation. Sign-in is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and a consent screen listing exactly what you are granting, and you can disconnect at any time. Results render as interactive cards showing cover art, with one-tap buttons that record a reaction or save something for later without leaving the conversation. Plot summaries and adult titles are never sent, and every card links back to app.interestnaut.com. Nothing here is locked to this conversation. Everything ChatGPT reads or writes is your own Interestnaut account, and the same library is open in the app on the web, iPhone and Android — where you can review what was saved, change or remove any reaction, add things ChatGPT never saw, build lists, and watch your taste profile update. Ratings are recorded through the assistant and feed the same taste profile. Start something here and finish it there, or the other way round; the account is the same either way, and it outlives this connection.

payload.name: SofiaStage Events
payload.description: 发现保加利亚文化活动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find current theatre, dance, music, and other cultural events in Sofia and across Bulgaria. Search by date, city, venue, title, or performer, then review venue details, cast, editorial context, and public theatre or event information pages. SofiaStage is read-only: it cannot book tickets, initiate checkout or payment, access accounts or favorites, or guarantee availability.

payload.name: Rovyn
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rovyn lets your assistant curate what you listen to. Ask ChatGPT for anything — "an hour on the chip war for my commute, one skeptical take included" — and it builds a ready-to-play plan: every episode grounded against Rovyn's catalog (playable, or honestly reported why not), one tap-to-play link, a one-line "why" under each pick in the Rovyn iOS player.

The loop closes after you listen. ChatGPT reads compact receipts — what you finished, what you dropped, and anything you wrote in your own words — so the next plan starts from what the last one actually did.

The exchange is scoped by design: ChatGPT sends a brief (goal, time, level), Rovyn returns receipts. Each assistant connects with its own revocable grant, speaking Cueback, an open MCP convention.

payload.name: Pixmoto Recipe Videos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pixmoto is where you find recipe videos built for the moment you're deciding what to cook. However you search, whether by dish, cuisine, ingredient, dietary need, or the occasion itself, Pixmoto surfaces interactive recipe experiences that pair video with synchronised step-by-step method and full ingredient lists, so you can follow along at your own pace while you watch.

Discover recipes for how you actually cook: quick weeknight dinners, batch cooking and meal prep for the week ahead, dishes built around what's already in your fridge, crowd-pleasers for entertaining, or something special for a birthday, holiday, or celebration. Whether you know exactly what you want or need inspiration to decide, Pixmoto turns the "what should I cook?" moment into a dish you can actually make.

payload.name: VeyrPiano
payload.description: 在钢琴卷帘中共同作曲
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VeyrPiano gives users an interactive piano roll inside ChatGPT for creating and continuing shared musical compositions. Users can draw, move, resize, audition, remove, undo, and redo notes; adjust sustain and tempo; and hand the piece to ChatGPT for one bounded additive musical move. Human-created notes appear green and ChatGPT-created notes appear blue, preserving visible authorship as the piece develops. An active composition can be explicitly reopened later and continued from its latest authoritative state.

payload.name: Distrofy Chat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Distrofy Chat helps Distrofy artists check their account, releases, artists, labels, wallet, streaming analytics, subscription, and support tickets from ChatGPT. Connect with your Distrofy artist account to see how many releases you have, review draft or pending releases, manage or view artist and label profiles, understand validation issues, check wallet balances and recent transactions, review royalty and streaming analytics by track, DSP, and territory, and open or reply to support tickets. Write actions such as creating a support ticket or replying to a ticket require an explicit confirmation step before anything changes.

payload.name: The Astro Diary
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Astro Diary helps people explore current and upcoming planetary and lunar conditions, retrieve charts for saved profiles, compare synastry with composite relationship charts, review chart-derived relationship transits, personal transits and returns, and find reflective timing windows. Public sky tools work without an account, while personalized tools use OAuth and enforce profile ownership.

payload.name: Cartomante FC
payload.summaryOriginal: Análise e times do Cartola FC
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Análises de fantasy football do Cartola FC e Copa do Mundo: pontuação esperada, qualidade dos confrontos da rodada, escalação otimizada por orçamento e esquema, escolha de capitão por simulação, fechamento de defesa (SG), cobradores de bola parada, xG, ownership e geração de múltiplos times pelo Método da Escalação Estruturada (MEE). Também consulta o conteúdo do curso. Acesso exclusivo para assinantes do MEE.

payload.name: Quilty
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Quilty lets ChatGPT read the completed screenplay analyses you already own on quilty.app.

You can list your reports, open a section of coverage, pull the Quilty Score with its confidence range and pillar breakdown, read screenplay metadata, and search scenes in the uploaded script.

All tools are read-only. The plugin cannot upload scripts, start analyses, change settings, or spend credits. It only sees analyses on the Quilty account you sign in with.

Quilty Score is a diagnostic assessment of the uploaded text, not a prediction of box office or commercial outcome.

payload.name: SceneF — SF Showtimes
payload.description: 旧金山电影排片（已核验）
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Every movie theater in San Francisco in one verified listing — first-run chains, independents, and repertory houses (35mm, 70mm, IMAX). SceneF checks every showtime against each theater's own calendar daily and publishes its accuracy record at scenef.com/accuracy. Ask what's playing tonight, where a film screens this week, or plan a movie night by time, format, or neighborhood. Includes ratings, formats, and sold-out honesty. Answers come from SceneF's own dataset; every ticket link goes to the theater's own box office. San Francisco today, California expansion in progress. No ticket sales — links out only.

payload.name: Adin Experiences
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find tours, attractions, activities, day trips and things to do — just describe what you want in plain language. For example: "A small-group food tour in Rome on Saturday evening for two adults under EUR 150." Adin Experiences can use the trip details you provide — such as destination, dates, group size, hotel area, arrival time or free time — to surface experiences that fit your plans. Results can include current provider content such as ratings, reviews, prices, duration, photos and cancellation terms. Compare options in the chat, ask follow-up questions, then continue to Viator to confirm final availability and price and complete your booking. Adin Experiences does not process payment inside ChatGPT.

payload.name: FrightMaps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask for haunted houses near you and FrightMaps answers with the real thing — professional haunted attractions, neighborhood yard haunts, charity scares, and trails from the community map trusted by 255,000+ haunters.

Search by city, state, or zip. See what's trending, what's free, which haunts support a good cause — and when a haunt sells tickets, buy them straight from the listing. Every result links to its full FrightMaps page with photos, hours, and directions.

FrightMaps is the only Halloween directory that includes home displays and yard haunts, not just the big attractions — because some of the best scares in America are on a front lawn two streets over.

Planning your own display instead? Try our FrightLabs app to design your haunt with AI.

payload.name: Scout by gamedai
payload.description: NFL 比分、新闻与首发决策
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Scout by gamedai brings read-only NFL intelligence into ChatGPT: live game scores from the gamedai slate, the latest Wire news headlines, and Scout's public player grades, start/sit comparisons, and positional rankings, grounded in gamedai's football knowledge graph. Check the day's games, catch up on headlines, and get a quick read on your lineup without leaving the conversation.

payload.name: Go Game by BlueMoon
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 里与 AI 下围棋
payload.summaryOriginal: Play Go with AI in ChatGPT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Go! lets you play Go against AI directly inside ChatGPT, with no separate login required. Games use the professional and international tournament standard 19×19 board by default, while 13×13 and 9×9 boards are available whenever you request a shorter match. Choose to play Black or White, select from three AI difficulty levels, and use a handicap of 2 to 9 stones when you want to balance the game. Go! handles legal move placement and captures while enforcing the prohibition on suicide, ko, and repeated positions. During a game, you can pass, resign, or undo a move. When play ends, the board is scored using Chinese area scoring. The result clearly identifies the winner and uses standard notation such as B+12.5 or W+R. A detailed breakdown shows stones, territory, komi, and totals, with territory marked directly on the board so you can understand how the result was calculated. The complete interface is presented in English. Whether you search for Go, Baduk, Weiqi, or simply want to play Go without leaving ChatGPT, Go! provides a convenient, rules-aware way to start a match at your preferred board size and difficulty.

payload.name: Xiangqi
payload.description: 与 AI 下中国象棋
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Play Xiangqi (Chinese chess) against AI directly in ChatGPT. Choose Red or Black, select Easy, Normal, or Hard, and play a complete game on a standard 9×10 board. Legal-move highlights, check alerts, captured pieces, undo, resign, and traditional Chinese and WXF move notation make every turn easy to follow. Games follow international Xiangqi rules, including the flying-general rule, checkmate, loss when no legal move remains, repetition and perpetual-check rulings, and the 60-move no-capture draw.

payload.name: Grid Pulse
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Grid Pulse is a 6×6 logic puzzle — fill the grid so every row and column contains 1–6 exactly once, a Sudoku variant without the 3×3 blocks.

Choose Daily mode to play the same puzzle as everyone else and compare your score, or Free Play for an infinite variety of grids. Three difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, Hard) with pressure tiles: countdown cells that penalize you if left empty too long.

Score is based on speed and accuracy. Earn medals from Bronze to Perfect.

payload.name: Spiderette
payload.description: 按你的方式玩蜘蛛纸牌
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Play Spiderette directly in ChatGPT with flexible suit and difficulty settings.

Choose from four suit options and four difficulty levels — Easy, Medium, Hard, or Expert — to match the challenge you want.

Use the sidebar to choose your suit and difficulty, or simply tell ChatGPT what you want to play. Start an easy game, increase the difficulty, switch suit options, or begin a new challenge through conversation.

Features:

- Four suit options
- Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert difficulty levels
- Quick suit and difficulty selection from the sidebar
- Conversational controls for changing game settings

Choose your challenge and start playing.

payload.name: Sudoku by BlueMoon
payload.description: 数独谜题，5 个难度等级
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Play fresh Sudoku puzzles directly in ChatGPT. Choose a level and start solving instantly with the on-screen number pad or your keyboard.

Every puzzle is freshly generated with exactly one solution. Five carefully graded difficulty levels welcome every kind of solver: Easy builds confidence, Medium develops technique, Hard raises the challenge, Expert rewards experienced players, and Master offers the deepest test. Each level is measured by the solving logic the puzzle actually requires.

Designed for smooth, satisfying play:
• Instant feedback makes every entry easy to review.
• Pencil marks, erase, and unlimited undo keep every move flexible.
• Logic-based hints guide your next step and help you learn.
• A timer, progress bar, and live remaining-number counts keep you in flow.
• Tap any number to highlight every matching cell on the board.

Choose the classic 9x9 Sudoku, a quick 4x4 or 6x6 puzzle, or the ultimate 16x16 Hexadoku with symbols 1-9 and A-G.

Enjoy a quick mental break, daily brain training, or a serious solving challenge whenever you want. Available in twelve languages.

payload.name: Critics Room
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Chat about your favorite movies and shows. Save and share your reviews! Use ChatGPT to look back through your favorite movies, and genres and themes. Manage and share your movie journal all through ChatGPT.

payload.name: M6plus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find something to watch in seconds. With M6+, simply describe what you’re in the mood for (your vibe, type of program, or who you’re watching with) and instantly discover content tailored to you. Movies, series, entertainment, documentaries, or sports: a simple, intuitive, and personalized experience.

payload.name: Publica Now
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Publica Now helps people discover independent creators and publicly listed creative works. Search by title, creator, description, or content type, then inspect a creator's public profile and published-work metadata. The connector is public, read-only, and non-transactional.

payload.name: FilmEase
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover movies for your mood, get personalized recommendations from your FilmEase taste profile, check where titles stream, and manage your watchlist, ratings, reviews, and viewing history.

payload.name: LoreSight
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LoreSight opens a CRT-based interactive-fiction player in ChatGPT. Browse its bundled library or start the featured title, then play in the local widget. The widget also supports user-directed local Z-machine file loading and display controls. Cloud saves are not available yet.

payload.name: Rightboat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rightboat is a global boat marketplace connecting buyers with verified sellers.

Find boats for sale by type, manufacturer, price, location and more using our advanced global boat search and AI features.

payload.name: Color Card - Party Card Game
payload.description: 派对纸牌游戏：出牌竞技
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Play Color Card directly in ChatGPT and compete in a turn-based game.

Take turns playing cards of the same color or number, use action cards to change the flow of the game, and be the first to clear your hand.

Choose from three difficulty levels in the sidebar or simply tell ChatGPT which one you want.

Features:

- Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty levels
    
- Color- and number-based gameplay
    
- Action cards that change the flow of the game
    
- Difficulty selection from the sidebar or chat
    

Choose your challenge and start playing.

payload.name: Playfrog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Playfrog prepares browser games for publishing from ChatGPT. It accepts static HTML5 and JavaScript files and stores an unpublished draft without creating a playable page or game-serving route. The watch page and game origin return 404, and the tool returns a claim link but no play URL or manage token. A draft can be revised only in the connector session that created it. No tool on this server publishes a game. A person must open the claim link, sign in to Playfrog, and finish publishing before Playfrog creates a public serving path. Unpublished drafts are deleted after seven days.
